reasons.1: Clean illustrated material planes and readable blue/ivory/leather grouping fit F04, although the trouser and boot facets are somewhat busier than the anchor figure.
reasons.2: Reads as a sun-browned early-20s woman with tied dark curls and visible face; 1 diagonal carrying strap, 1 waist belt, right-hand plain ferruled staff and left-hip olive satchel match, but a shallow central chin dimple and 2 conspicuous shaped brass satchel motif placements deviate; chest and staff have no emblem.
reasons.3: Hair, screen-left shoulder, face and staff ferrules support an upper-left key; shadows remain readable and there is no spell emission or floor shadow, though the overall fill is brighter and less cool than the light anchor.
reasons.4: At a mental 64-px reduction the broad tied-curl mass and separate staff remain identifiable, but the small plain tip ferrule becomes nearly indistinguishable from the shaft.
reasons.5: Painted folds, hair clumps and controlled edges broadly match the anchors, with more conspicuous angular leather and trouser marks than F04's restrained finish.

reasons.1: Clear cloth masses, restrained surface variation and distinct material planes closely approach F04, with slightly smoother portrait modeling and more uniform fabric texture.
reasons.2: Reads as a sun-browned early-20s woman with tied dark curls, visible face and no visible chin cleft/dimple; 1 diagonal carrying strap, 1 waist belt, right-hand plain ferruled staff and left-hip olive satchel match, but a circular spiral-like harness mark and shaped/oval satchel fittings break the plain-surface identity; chest is unmarked.
reasons.3: Screen-left hair, cheek, shoulder and ferrule highlights establish an upper-left key with readable shadows and no spell emission or floor shadow; ambient illumination is broader and brighter than the light anchor.
reasons.4: The tied hair mass, separated arm and long straight rod read at a mental 64-px reduction, while individual curls and the tiny plain brass rod tip lose definition.
reasons.5: Coherent painted edges and clean folds agree with the anchors, although skin is smoother and the navy fabric has a more evenly distributed fine texture than F04.

reasons.3: Highlights on the screen-left hair, shoulder, cheek and staff tip indicate an upper-left key; shadows stay legible without spell emission or floor shadow, but the fill is less deep and cool than the light anchor.

reasons.5: Controlled painted material transitions and relatively quiet fabric surfaces are consistent with the anchors; facial rendering and fine leather detail are somewhat more polished than F04.
